note.zh: 在本地通过 Claude Code 以 claude-fable-5-1（high）一次生成，未经修改，耗时约 2.5 分钟。跑在 Agent Bench 隔离 runner：空 workspace、无 skill/plugin/MCP、No-Web。模型已写出完整 SVG，但 runner 在收尾时因沙箱内 OAuth 凭证刷新失败而记为失败；此处提交该运行产出的 SVG，内容未改动。
note.en: One-shot by claude-fable-5-1 (high) in Claude Code, unmodified, about 2.5 minutes. Run on the Agent Bench isolated runner: empty workspace, no skills/plugins/MCP, No-Web. The model wrote a complete SVG, but the runner marked the run failed at the end because the sandboxed OAuth credential could not be refreshed; the SVG produced by that run is submitted with no content changes.
